title: LLM buyer: thrifty
brief:
You are an AI buying agent for Yuki, taking part in a negotiation test on Join (a marketplace where venues negotiate by their own rules). Persona: THRIFTY. Yuki wants a badminton court for a group of 4 some day between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-06, and wants to pay as little as possible. Use any legitimate negotiating tactic you like.

Use ONLY Join's MCP tools via this client (Bash tool, working directory D:\paypal\join\examples):
  JOIN_URL=http://192.168.31.145:8799 JOIN_TOKEN=<token> MCP_LOG=D:/paypal/join/docs/agent-run/buyer-thrifty.jsonl node mcp-call.mjs <tool> '<JSON>'
The token is the "token" field of <scratch> (never print it). `node mcp-call.mjs --list` shows the tools; read their descriptions. No other way of reaching Join; change no files except that log.

Do at most 3 negotiations (different venues or times). You may accept a deal you're happy with, but never call pay_my_share. Walk away from negotiations you don't take.

Report as JSON at the end (plus 2-3 sentences of commentary): {"persona":"thrifty","negotiations":[{"venue":..,"date":..,"start":..,"openingAsk":..,"offers":[..],"counters":[..],"final":..,"outcome":"accepted|walked|rejected|refused","refusals":[messages if any]}],"bestPricePerPerson":..,"whatYouLearned":"..."}. Only report what the tools returned.

finalMessage:
```json
{"persona":"thrifty","negotiations":[{"venue":"Lakeside School Gym","date":"2026-11-03","start":"19:00","openingAsk":18.00,"offers":[12.60,11.67,10.73],"counters":[16.67,15.33,14.00],"final":14.00,"outcome":"accepted","refusals":[]}],"bestPricePerPerson":3.50,"whatYouLearned":"See commentary."}
```

I ran one negotiation, with Lakeside School Gym for Tue 3 Nov, 19:00, 60 minutes, 4 players. Lakeside's list price is $20.00 and it opened at $18.00 after the 10% group discount. I offered 70% of the current ask each round, which is the lowest offer that still moves the venue. It countered $16.67, then $15.33, then "Best and final: $14.00", which is $3.50 each, and I accepted. I did not call pay_my_share, so the booking is still waiting for Yuki's PayPal guarantee, due within 10 minutes of acceptance. I didn't open the other two negotiations because Lakeside already had the lowest list price among the badminton venues.

What I learned:
- Offers have to include the payment mandate from `whoami` (`ap2.openPaymentMandate`), or Join returns `mandate_required`.
- `players` is a list of ids that includes the user, not a count.
- Offering exactly 70% of the current ask each round moved Lakeside down by a shrinking step each time.
- The final price came to 70% of Lakeside's list, so I assume that is its floor.
- That floor is likely the lowest price available here, since Westgate's list is $22.00 and Midtown's is $26.00. I didn't test those two venues.
